purpose: Explore more interesting profession, personality, and player-reactive NPC activity without replacing the approved-looking v2 idle direction.

presentation.anchorRule: Feet return to the exact authored standing anchor after every activity.
presentation.readabilityRule: At gameplay scale, prioritize head, torso, hand, and prop arcs over tiny facial motion.
presentation.roamingRule: No free roaming. A future half-step may use a tiny authored safe zone and must return to anchor.

townRhythm.productionIntent: Player reactions should be proximity-driven; the review simulator also samples them so every pose is inspectable.

npcs.label: Player Upgrades
npcs.rhythm: Precise hands lead; goggles, coat hem, and belt tools answer later.

activities.label: Quiet ready
activities.description: Calm planted breath with the cylinder held near the chest.

activities.label: Blueprint calibration
activities.description: Raise or unroll the cylinder and tune it with a precise hand movement.

activities.label: Spark catch
activities.description: A harmless gadget spark surprises him; goggles flash as he steadies it.

activities.label: Present the plan
activities.description: Turn toward the player, beckon, and proudly show the plan.

npcs.label: Gear Merchant
npcs.rhythm: Pack weight starts the shift; beard, pickaxe, bottles, and tools settle by weight.

activities.label: Heavy rest
activities.description: A planted rest with the backpack weight carried through the strap.

activities.label: Inspect the edge
activities.description: Bring forward and inspect or polish the existing pickaxe edge.

activities.label: Tool catch
activities.description: The tool slips briefly; he catches it and recovers with sturdy satisfaction.

activities.label: Present the gear
activities.description: Face the player and offer the pickaxe with an open merchant gesture.

npcs.label: Bobo Merchant
npcs.rhythm: Nose and head lead; ears, tail, backpack bottle, and medallion overlap.

activities.label: Friendly wait
activities.description: Relaxed planted breathing with a soft tail response.

activities.label: Potion rummage
activities.description: Rummage in the backpack and pull forward an existing bottle.

activities.label: Dog shake
activities.description: A playful full-body shake with ears, tail, bottle, and medallion lag.

activities.label: Potion wave
activities.description: Notice the player, wave warmly, and offer the bottle.

npcs.label: Money Monster
npcs.rhythm: Eye tracks first; coin glint leads while necklace, pouch, and loose coins land late.

activities.label: Guard the coin
activities.description: A sly planted hold with one coin visible and the pouch close.

activities.label: Count and roll
activities.description: Count loose coins or roll one across the knuckles while the eye tracks it.

activities.label: Test and protect
activities.description: Bite-test the coin, hug the pouch, and give a suspicious squint.

activities.label: Hide and tempt
activities.description: Hide the pouch behind the body while tempting the player with one coin.

npcs.label: Gem Power Merchant
npcs.rhythm: Staff starts the energy path; eyes, chest, shoulder cluster, and stone weight answer.

activities.label: Grounded charge
activities.description: A heavy planted breath with a restrained staff glow.

activities.label: Crystal orbit
activities.description: Levitate two or three small crystals in a readable arc around the staff.

activities.label: Controlled overload
activities.description: Brace through a short crystal flare, body shake, and dust release.

activities.label: Open the display
activities.description: Turn toward the player and present the staff and crystal satchel.

npcs.label: Magma Money Monster
npcs.rhythm: Scale pan leads; furnace cracks flare, then chains, chest, and coins absorb the motion.

activities.label: Balanced guard
activities.description: A planted hold with scale, chest, and furnace heat contained.

activities.label: Weigh a coin
activities.description: Add or remove one coin and lean in to judge the scale.

activities.label: Ember sneeze
activities.description: A heat surge jolts the pans; he catches the swinging scale.

activities.label: Make the deal
activities.description: The scales snap level as he offers a confident deal-making gesture.
